items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23

ctx.x: Joe Sutler you think could match pretty close to Kepler? Yeah, pretty close. And then Louie, Louie stepped up where we're both up. Yeah. He was recording. Strange that Sutler never got

properly recorded. No, he never did do very much. His work of the Edgar was on the ground. Yeah, the way they did with Kepard, the way they spotted him, was supposed to be a hokum man in those days, you call him. Outside man, hokum. He was ready to play with those hot dancers. He played down. And for the punch, then he called Freddie. He said Freddie would get up and take his jelly band. And he played over the band. And the band just went along and called him and some sort of a riff. And Boston they called it.…
